Class StarLustMessierCsvRepository

Namespace: ChargerAstronomyEngine.Data.Messier
Assembly: ChargerAstronomyEngine.dll

Handles retrieving data from the csv listing of Messier Deep Space Objects retrieved from Starlust.org If a new repository is used, a new converter that implements the ChargerAstronomyShared.Contracts.Repositories.IMessierRepository needs to be created for it.

public sealed class StarLustMessierCsvRepository : IMessierRepository
